entry_points.text: Guest boundary provides irq-disabled enter/exit plus irq-saving exit wrapper around the transition.
Device entries are create, deferred init, destroy, release on close, attr handlers and control/map handlers.
Host ioctls: get-api-version 0, create-vm 1, msr-list 2, check-extension 3, vcpu-mmap-size 4, supported-cpuid 5, enable-sie 6, emulated-cpuid 9, msr-features 10.

exports.text: Slot helpers report emptiness, derive ids, convert hva to gfn and test gpa membership; guest access pins managed pages, faults pfns, checked get/put fault on invalid and dirty on write, expect alloc failures, plus readonly vcpu map.
Arch defaults allocate and free zeroed VM storage, report unsupported for remote TLB flush with and without range, report intc initialized, and make irqfd init and exit trivial.
Generic VM counters track remote TLB flushes and requests; generic VCPU counters track halt-poll success, attempts, timing totals, log histograms and blocking.

hazards.text: Routing map length binds to entry count; slot generation assumes no practical wraparound; do not use raw srcu index directly.
Default gmem lookup bugs the VM and fails IO, never succeeds; destroy and release are exclusive, release suppresses destroy and callers tolerate either teardown order.
Signal mask flex bytes need length checks; ioctl and cap numbers have gaps, use exact values.

invariants.text: Second dirty bitmap follows first; gmem maps with conditional shared init; manual caps equal protect-enable; slots use id/hva/gfn indexes, 7-bit hash, generation cache; map class picks ro or rw by suffix.
Histograms saturate via external min/div/fls helpers, linear and log, clamping overflow to last bucket; mmu retry checks in-progress then sequence with barrier ordering.
Ioeventfd length zero skips matching else exact widths; some capability queries return counts rather than booleans.

locks.text: Slot mutation uses slots mutex with nested arch mutex or srcu to avoid swap deadlock; mmu updates use mm lock; per-vcpu mutex, irq, resample, routing, ring, cache and async locks isolate small paths.
Retry check observes in-progress before sequence, pairing with completion barrier; on one platform it runs under per-page lock without global mmu lock.
Device create and release hold vm lock with deferred init outside; resampler lists use rcu with resampler lock; irqfd routing updates under eventfd lock with seqlock.

state_machines.text: VCPU mode cycles outside, inside, exiting with shadow-table-read for inspection; enter/exit helpers bracket guest execution preserving irq state.
Slots change as create/delete/move/flags against dual copies by generation; async faults move queued to done; dirty toggles single/dual bitmaps plus optional ring.
Device goes create to deferred init, stays attached until destroy or release; release detaches and suppresses destroy; destroy may precede or follow IO teardown.
MP states run from runnable 0, uninit 1, init-received 2, halted 3, sipi 4, stopped 5, check-stop 6, operating 7, load 8, ap-reset-hold 9 to suspended 10 in one u32.

structs.text: VCPU has VM link, cpu, id, mode, requests, mutex, run area and poll plus async lists, mmio fragments, flags and cached slot; host map holds pages and addrs; async item has lists, addrs and flags; gfn range has slot, bounds, filter and context flags.

Slot has dual ids, hva interval, gfn nodes, base, pages, bitmap, arch, userspace addr, flags and optional memfd; generation groups trees, hash and active index; iterator walks gfn order via active nodes; VM holds mm locks, slot sets, vcpus, counters, caches, locks and buses plus irq, stats, notifiers, devices and polling.
Routing entry maps global number and type via level callback to irqchip pin or MSI payload, linkable in hash; table holds pin matrix, count and flexible hash heads by number.

Device holder links ops, VM, private data and list node; ops has name, create/init/destroy/release, attrs and control/map; resampler links VM, sharing list and ack notifier; irqfd holds VM, routing entry, number, works, resample and bypass links.

GVA/HVA use word width, GPA/GFN/HPA/HFN/PFN use 64-bit with PFN aliasing HFN; invalid GPA is all-ones, poll hist has 32 buckets, stat names 48 bytes; hva cache has generation and addrs, pfn cache adds VM, locks and flags; mmu cache is freelist pool; generic stats hold flush and poll counters with hists.

Memory region has slot, flags, guest addr, size and userspace addr, extended with memfd offset/fd and padding; flags are log-dirty, readonly, guest-memfd; irq level has number/status and level, chip has id and state overlay; run starts with request/exit reason/regs then union of hw, fail, exception, io, debug and mmio payloads.
Limits: guest pages 2^31-1, total slots SHRT_MAX with zero internal, dirty ring 64 reserved up to 65536, irq routes 4096, API version 12 with guest debug present.

Exits: unknown 0, exception 1, io 2, hypercall 3, debug 4, hlt 5, mmio 6, irq-window 7, shutdown 8, fail-entry 9, intr 10, set-tpr 11, nmi 16, internal-error 17, system-event 24, ioapic-eoi 26, rdmsr 29, wrmsr 30, dirty-full 31, ap-reset-hold 32, bus-lock 33, notify 37, mem-fault 39, tdx 40, snp-certs 43; internal emulation 1, simul-ex 2, delivery 3, unexpected 4 with instr-bytes bit0; io in 0 out 1; shutdown 1 reset 2.
Coalesced zone/transaction/ring handle deferred IO; translation, interrupt, dirty/clear, tpr, vapic and pit config cover controls; guest debug, ioeventfd and enable-cap plus snp certs complete ABI.

Caps: irqchip 0, hlt 1 through user-memory 3, destroy 21, reinject 24, routing 25, join 30, mce 31, irqfd 32, pit2 33, boot-cpu 34, pit-state2 35, ioeventfd 36, adjust 39, vcpu-events 41, debugregs 50, robust-step 51, xsave 55, xcrs 56, ppc-pvinfo 57; higher to 227 with gaps, some return counts.
